description: This Java class, TaxRatesController, manages HTTP requests related to tax rate operations within an admin panel of a web application, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and editing tax rates.

classes.name: TaxRatesController
classes.description: Controller handling CRUD operations and management of tax rates in the admin interface, including listing, editing, deleting, and saving tax rates.

methods.name: displayTaxRates
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a list of tax rates for the current store, including setting up the model attributes for rendering.

methods.name: pageTaxRates
methods.description: Handles POST requests to return a paginated list of tax rates in JSON format, suitable for AJAX-based UI updates.

methods.name: saveTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new tax rate after form submission, validating and then persisting it.

methods.name: updateTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing tax rate, including validation.

methods.name: removeTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a tax rate by its ID, returning JSON response status.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load a specific tax rate into an edit form based on given ID.

methods.name: validateTaxRate
methods.description: Validates the information of a TaxRate object, including uniqueness of code and correctness of numeric fields.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the active menu and menu structure in the model.
